en: Sepia-toned historic street scene labeled "EISLEBEN Plan" showing a central square with a small pavilion and pond in the foreground, surrounded by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with shopfronts. People walk across the open square; tram tracks run through it. In the distant background are church towers rising above the town's rooftops. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.
